_comment: Demo-asset mapping. Keys are nominal audio paths that tests and demo scripts use (all are excluded upstream resources -- ASVspoof 2019 LA eval clips and one synthetic benchmark clip). Values are shipped SYNTHETIC replacements in demo_audio/ (generated by make_demo_audio.py with fixed seeds; no recordings, no dataset audio). Resolution lives in scripts/demo_assets.js resolve(); a path that exists on disk always wins over this mapping, so real data is never shadowed.
